newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL WIN TOSS, BAT FIRST AGAINST BORDER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL WIN TOSS, BAT FIRST AGAINST BORDER.

text.p: Natal captain Dale Benkenstein won the toss and decided to bat first on the opening day of the four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Natal at Kingsmead on Friday.
Natal - Doug Watson, Rudi Steyn, Errol Stewart, Neil Johnson, Dale Benkenstein (captain), Mark Bruyns, Shaun Pollock, Keith Forde, Anthony Botha, Gary Gilder, Tertius Bosch.
Border - Pieter Strydom (captain), Brad White, Piet Botha, Frans Cronje, Peter Kirsten, Mark Boucher, Steve Palframan, Vasbert Drakes, Ian Howell, Brendan Horan, Makhaya Ntini.
